title: Microsoft thinks its new Copilot ‘super app’ will be as influential as Office
description: After teasing its new Copilot "super app" last month, Microsoft is officially unveiling it today. As part of the launch, Microsoft is also rebranding Scout, the AI personal assistant it unveiled at Build earlier this year, as Autopilot. […]
